changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for generating game account market and listing data reports from mall.yy.com and gamemarket.yy.com.
- Supports requests for market-level trends, recent transaction overviews, price distributions, and listing samples for various games.
- Responds to trigger phrases like “游戏账号行情”, “账号价格分析”, and “挂牌数据”.
- Includes command-based workflow to fetch and summarize data into Markdown reports.
- Uses adjustable depth and game filters based on user input (supports quick looks and in-depth analyses).
- Clearly distinguishes between market overview reports and single account valuations.
